name: Graham Neubig
bio: Graham Neubig is an associate professor at the Language Technologies Institute at Carnegie Mellon University and co-founder and Chief Scientist of All Hands AI, the company behind the open-source OpenHands coding agent. The project began as OpenDevin in 2024 and was renamed OpenHands. Research focuses on NLP and large language models.
known_for: Chief Scientist at All Hands AI
NLP and LLM research at CMU
